Collaborative learning environments such as programming labs are crucial for learning experiential hands-on skills such as critical thinking and problem solving, and peer discussion. arxiv-2212-03652.title: Questions in linear recurrence: From the T ⊕ T T\oplus T -problem to lineability
arxiv-2212-03652.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by . We study, for a continuous linear operator T T on an F-space X X , when the direct sum operator T ⊕ T T\oplus T is recurrent on X ⊕ X X\oplus X . In particular: we establish the analogous notion, for recurrence, to that of (topological) weak-mixing for transitivity/hypercyclicity, namely quasi-rigidity ; and we construct a recurrent but not quasi-rigid operator on each separable infinite-dimensional Banach space, solving the T ⊕ T T\oplus T -recurrence problem in the negative way.

arxiv-2309-03998.description: Abstract The Chambolle–Pock method is a versatile three-parameter algorithm designed to solve a broad class of composite convex optimization problems, which encompass two proper, lower semicontinuous, and convex functions, along with a linear operator L L . The functions are accessed via their proximal operators, while the linear operator is evaluated in a forward manner.

pmc-11357467.title: Enhanced TiO2-Based Photocatalytic Volatile Organic Compound Decomposition Combined with Ultrasonic Atomization in the Co-Presence of Carbon Black and Heavy Metal Nanoparticles
pmc-11357467.creator: Zen Maeno, Mika Nishitani, Takehiro Saito, Kazuhiko Sekiguchi, Naoki Kagi, Norikazu Namiki
pmc-11357467.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Volatile organic compounds (VOCs) are representative indoor air pollutants that negatively affect the human body owing to their toxicity. One of the most promising methods for VOC removal is photocatalytic degradation using TiO2. In this study, the addition of carbon black (CB) and heavy metal nanoparticles (NPs) was investigated to improve the efficiency of a TiO2-based photocatalytic VOC decomposition system combined with ultrasonic atomization and ultraviolet irradiation, as described previously. The addition of CB and Ag NPs significantly improved the degradation efficiency.

pmc-11499305.title: A Case of Idiopathic Twenty-Nail Dystrophy
pmc-11499305.creator: Radha Kumar, Ashikabanu Mujibur Rahman, Navin Umapathy, Shami Kumar, Vaanmathi Azhagar Nambi Santhi
pmc-11499305.description: In children, nail diseases can be either congenital or acquired, with an occurrence rate of 3 to 11% in the pediatric population. In both fingers and toes, rough, accentuated linear ridges of the nails are referred to as trachyonychia. This condition most commonly occurs in childhood, with a higher prevalence in males.

pmc-11603670.title: Relationship between stroke and estimated glucose disposal rate: results from two prospective cohort studies
pmc-11603670.creator: Yutong Han, Kexin Zhang, Yue Luo, Bin Wan, Yaowen Zhang, Qinchuan Huang, Hanyu Liu, Yulin Leng, Chunguang Xie
pmc-11603670.description: BackgroundInsulin resistance (IR) is a recognized contributor to stroke association, and the estimated glucose disposal rate (eGDR) is a dependable indicator of IR. However, the specific connections between eGDR, stroke prevalence, and overall mortality have not been thoroughly investigated. This study aimed to examine how eGDR correlates with stroke and overall death rate.

pmc-12022869.title: From despair to hope: tackling Balochistan's suicide crisis with sustainable solutions
pmc-12022869.creator: Mehr Muhammad Adeel Riaz, Imrana Imdad, Butool Hisam, Muhammad Zeshan
pmc-12022869.description: Balochistan, Pakistan's largest province, faces a concerning rise in self-harm and suicide, exacerbated by socioeconomic challenges, political instability and events such as climate change and recent suicide bombings. Despite the alarming suicide mortality rate, it remains a neglected public health issue.

pmc-13336213.title: Age and tumor size as independent predictors of malignancy in BI-RADS 4 and 5 breast lesions: A cross-sectional study in Vietnam
pmc-13336213.creator: De Van Nguyen, Trung Van Pham, Tam Huu Dinh, Dung Ngoc Tran, Chung Thanh Dang, Dongling Wu, Dongling Wu, Dongling Wu, Dongling Wu
pmc-13336213.description: BackgroundAccurate diagnosis of suspicious breast lesions (BI-RADS 4/5) is crucial for appropriate clinical management. The International Academy of Cytology (IAC) Yokohama System standardizes fine-needle aspiration (FNA) cytology reporting, but its performance and the role of independent clinical predictors within this specific high-risk cohort require further investigation.

pmc-13363545.title: Biventricular Systolic Function and Myocardial Deformation in Liver Cirrhosis: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Speckle-Tracking Echocardiography and Cardiac Magnetic Resonance Feature Tracking Studies
pmc-13363545.creator: Andrea Sonaglioni, Michele Lombardo, Giulio Francesco Gramaglia, Lorenzo Canova, Maria Grazia Rumi, Gian Luigi Nicolosi, Massimo Baravelli, Federica Cerini
pmc-13363545.description: Background: Liver cirrhosis is frequently associated with cardiovascular abnormalities collectively referred to as cirrhotic cardiomyopathy, characterized by impaired cardiac reserve and subclinical myocardial dysfunction despite preserved conventional systolic function. Advanced myocardial deformation imaging techniques, including two-dimensional speckle-tracking echocardiography (2D-STE) and cardiac magnetic resonance feature tracking (CMR-FT), may allow earlier detection of subtle ventricular impairment.

pmc-13406857.title: Bioinspired Origami Morphing Limbs for Amphibious Robot Locomotion
pmc-13406857.creator: Yuxuan Li, Siyu Mei, Rensong Yin, Chong Liu, Hui Chen
pmc-13406857.description: Amphibious robots must reconcile two distinct mechanical requirements within a compact locomotion architecture. Terrestrial operation requires limb structures with sufficient load-bearing capacity, contact stability, and bending resistance, whereas aquatic operation benefits from a larger projected area for drag-based thrust generation.

pmc-13696649.title: Community Assembly Mechanisms Facilitate Understanding of Microbial Responses to Habitat Transition along a Spatial Environmental Continuum in Alpine Plateaus
pmc-13696649.creator: Wenrui Wang, Changjiang Huang, Congrui Liu
pmc-13696649.description: While soil microorganisms mediate important ecosystem functions, their community assembly mechanisms along a spatially connected environmental continuum remain elusive. Here, we profiled the taxonomic and functional characteristics of soil microbiomes across three independent wetland-grassland-bareland continua on the Pamir Plateau. Along this spatial environmental continuum, microbial diversity, network complexity, and network stability decreased significantly towards barelands.
